name: The Departed
source:
You were on your way home at night, when all of a sudden your car breaks down. You have to stop and see what exactly is broken, but as soon as you get out of the car, you are greeted by a strange woman offering her help. She invites you to go with her to the city, which just a couple of moments ago was not on your way.
